reviews.title: HIGHLY recommend
reviews.comment: Product: Air75 V3 with Blush Switches in ANSI layout. Received this today, and I have to say, this is by far one of the best tech purchases I’ve made so far this year. Quite frankly, in a while. The keyboard came 50% charged and made connecting to multiple devices via bluetooth, the 2.4ghz dongle, and even wired, seamless, easy, and intuitive. I haven’t used it long enough to determine what connectivity will look like after some usage, but I can confidently say that I’m looking forward to using the keyboard everyday to test this. The Air75 v3 looks slim, but practical, simple, but elegant. It’s the perfect blend of function, purpose, and focus. For just around $150, I can say that there is no buyers remorse around so far. The keys feel weighty enough to confidently hit each keystroke with a gentle thock. The version I ordered came with the blush switches (use mainly in office) so I prioritized noise over thockiness, however, it still thocks quite well. I’d argue that it’s probably just as quiet or if not quiter than some scissors switches from enterprise cookie cutter keyboards. The package came with additional keycaps to switch from MacOS to Windows, knob accessories, and a cable for wired connections. This made the set up to to switch layouts very easy. Only complaints (minimal so I’m not even going to dock a star): the blossom keys are VERY quiet. If I weren’t planning to have this be my daily in office use, I’d go with the brown or cherry switches. The blossom switches are a bit too dampened, so the feedback (keys resetting position or return height) can sometimes feel not as responsive. This is something to get used to, however it doesn’t really affect the typing experience overall. The other complaints would be with the instructions on how to navigate the keyboard settings, remembering which button combination does what… gave me old game shark cheat code memories… regardless, this is expected with simple keyboards, once set, it should “just work”. Which it has proven to, so far! Overall, I would HIGHLY recommend this to anyone who wants an upgrade in their office set up, want a more minimalist approach, and need focus/declutter.
reviews.author: Xiong Yang

reviews.title: Very portable, and very cool.
reviews.comment: This cute little keyboard is getting a ton of attention on my work desk.  I appreciate the aesthetic of it, but I really love the easy of typing on it. It’s very satisfying with the brown switches and not so loud that my colleagues are bothered.  I have asked a few times and they would not hesitate to tell me if it was too loud. Set up was easy, but note that the initial set up is much easier if you are using the wired connection. I had to find an adapter as the provided cable is USB A to USB C, and my MacBook can’t accommodate USB A. Switching from a top right corner key to a knob was very easy and they provide everything you need.  I  thought the knob might be a little gimmicky, but I find myself using it frequently. The RGB function is something that I will use only occasionally, but it does work well and has tons of customization.
reviews.author: Kerrie_T

reviews.title: Amazing 75% keyboard
reviews.comment: Genuinely amazing typing experience. The switches could have a bit more of a tactile feel but nothing wrong per se. The keyboard feels well made, not like it's going to fall apart at any time. The typing sound itself, that chonky sound" is incredibly satisfying. I didn't buy it for gaming, but in day to day activity I don't notice any meaningful delay in typing, regardless of connection mode. Solid investment
reviews.author: Alex

reviews.title: Great improvement. King of the low profile keyboards all around
reviews.comment: If you have been a fan of Nuphy keyboards, you'll feel right at home. This is a noticeable improvement over the V2 (which I loved) but was torn between the LoFree because it offered a much better typing feel. This improvement fixes all of that. The gasket mount makes a huge difference compared to the V2 and the connectivity issues I used to have with the V2 are absent. Typing feel is incredible for a low profile keyboard and have no complaints. Ultimately went with the Brown switches, but the red ones were great if you enjoy a linear experience. Battery life is excellent even with the backlights on. Also appreciate the new keycap color scheme. Still feels unique, but predominantly simple. Included keycaps allow you to make the board entirely neutral colored if you don't appreciate the pop of color. Overall, no complaints and couldn't recommend this keyboard enough. One thing to note is that if you are coming from a V2, the lowest typing angle is a bit higher on this one. You get used to it, but I really became accustomed to the lower one.
reviews.author: Tech Guru

reviews.title: Great keyboard bad quality control.
reviews.comment: First off, let me say I love this keyboard. I opted for the blush nano switches which feel amazing. I didn't want a loud clicky switch and this provides a good THOCK but yet remains quiet in my office setting. However, the USB port has malfunctioned and it can no longer recognize the device via USB within a week of ownership (which doesn't bode well). Luckily, I can still use the keyboard in wireless mode until the replacement arrives. I would normally just cut my losses, but I am attempting to get a replacement unit as like I stated previously I really do like this keyboard. Update- Amazon's replacement was incorrect (it was a used unit and someone swapped it out for a totally different keyboard). Bad quality control on Amazon's behalf. Lowering to one star. Do better
